- [Skip to main content](https://parks.canada.ca/lhn-nhs/nl/meadows#wb-cont) - [Skip to "About government"](https://parks.canada.ca/lhn-nhs/nl/meadows#wb-info) - [Switch to basic HTML version](https://parks.canada.ca/lhn-nhs/nl/meadows?wbdisable=true) ![A view of a canvas tent in front of a wood building covered in grass from the Viking encampment at L'Anse aux Meadows National Historic Site](https://pcweb2.azureedge.net/-/media/lhn-nhs/nl/meadows/WET4/LAM-location-1920x480.jpg?modified=20221124195312) Photo: Guillaume Paquette-Jetten # L'Anse aux Meadows National Historic Site At the tip of Newfoundland’s Great Northern Peninsula lies the first known evidence of European presence in the Americas. Here Norse expeditions sailed from Greenland, building a small encampment of timber-and-sod buildings over 1000 years ago Against a stunning backdrop of rugged cliffs, bog, and coastline, discover the fascinating archaeological remains of the Viking encampment, declared a UNESCO World Heritage Site in 1978. You’ll meet costumed Viking interpreters as you tour the recreated base camp and discover original artifacts from this internationally renowned archaeological find. [![](https://pcweb2.azureedge.net/-/media/lhn-nhs/nl/meadows/WET4/LAM-sagas-and-shadows-640x360.jpg?modified=20221125184721)](https://parks.canada.ca/lhn-nhs/nl/meadows/activ/decouverte-tours) ### [Sagas and shadows](https://parks.canada.ca/lhn-nhs/nl/meadows/activ/decouverte-tours) Come face to face with a Viking, as you take part in an evening of Viking myth and storytelling from the Vinland Sagas to ancient folktales, in an intimate, hour-long performance, warmed by the kitchen fire. [![](https://pcweb2.azureedge.net/-/media/lhn-nhs/nl/meadows/WET4/LAM-two-worlds-tour-640x360.jpg?modified=20221125184721)](https://parks.canada.ca/lhn-nhs/nl/meadows/activ/decouverte-tours) ### [The meeting of two worlds tour](https://parks.canada.ca/lhn-nhs/nl/meadows/activ/decouverte-tours) Learn how archaeology informs our understanding of the history of this UNESCO World Heritage Site, as a knowledgeable interpreter guide places the significance of these Norse archeological remains within the story of human movement. [![](https://pcweb2.azureedge.net/-/media/lhn-nhs/nl/meadows/WET4/LAM-viking-encampment-640x360.jpg?modified=20221125184721)](https://parks.canada.ca/lhn-nhs/nl/meadows/activ/decouverte-tours) ### [Viking encampment](https://parks.canada.ca/lhn-nhs/nl/meadows/activ/decouverte-tours) Discover in the site’s living history program, The Viking Encampment. Norse encampment. You’ll meet Viking characters and step back 1,000 years to experience life and exploration in the Viking Age. ## Visiting L'Anse aux Meadows National Historic Site ### [Activities and experiences](https://parks.canada.ca/lhn-nhs/nl/meadows/activ) Things to do, trails, tours, programs, itineraries. ### [Plan your visit](https://parks.canada.ca/lhn-nhs/nl/meadows/visit) How to get here, local attractions, accessibility, facilities and services. ### [Safety and guidelines](https://parks.canada.ca/lhn-nhs/nl/meadows/bulletins) Important bulletins, trail conditions, seasonal safety, site regulations. ## About L'Anse aux Meadows National Historic Site ### [Culture and history](https://parks.canada.ca/lhn-nhs/nl/meadows/culture) History, culture, cultural landscape, designation information. ### [Stewardship and management](https://parks.canada.ca/lhn-nhs/nl/meadows/info) Jobs, partners, film permits, research permits, public consultations, plans, and policies. | | ### Contact us - Telephone: - 709-623-2608 (May-October) - 709-458-2417 (November-May) - Email: [lanseauxmeadows@pc.gc.ca](mailto:lanseauxmeadows@pc.gc.ca) ### Hours of operation **Open June 1 to October 2, 2026** Every day, from 9 am to 5 pm [Complete Hours](https://parks.canada.ca/lhn-nhs/nl/meadows/visit/heures-hours) ## More places to discover with Parks Canada [![](https://pcweb2.azureedge.net/-/media/WET4/proximite-nearby/nl/Gros-Morne-NP-location-640x360.jpg?modified=20221126220707)](https://parks.canada.ca/pn-np/nl/grosmorne) ### [Gros Morne National Park](https://parks.canada.ca/pn-np/nl/grosmorne) Cruise sheer-walled fjords and hike diverse landscapes from windswept shorelines to sub-Arctic summits. Explore rare geological oddities that earned Gros Morne UNESCO World Heritage status, and relax amid the culture of Newfoundland’s coastal communities. [![](https://pcweb2.azureedge.net/-/media/WET4/proximite-nearby/nl/Port-au-Choix-NHS-location-640x360.jpg?modified=20221126220708)](https://parks.canada.ca/lhn-nhs/nl/portauchoix) ### [Port au Choix National Historic Site](https://parks.canada.ca/lhn-nhs/nl/portauchoix) See prehistoric artifacts from four ancient Aboriginal cultures that inhabited Newfoundland’s rugged northwest coast. Visit an ancient burial ground, hike coastal trails and see prehistoric artifacts including slate spears, harpoon tips and ivory daggers. [![](https://pcweb2.azureedge.net/-/media/WET4/proximite-nearby/nl/Red-Bay-NHS-location-640x360.jpg?modified=20221126220708)](https://parks.canada.ca/lhn-nhs/nl/redbay) ### [Red Bay National Historic Site](https://parks.canada.ca/lhn-nhs/nl/redbay) Red Bay was once the largest and most important commercial whaling station in the world. See the restored chalupa, explore archaeological treasures and original artifacts from the period at this UNESCO World Heritage site. [![](https://pcweb2.azureedge.net/-/media/WET4/proximite-nearby/nl/Torngat-Mountains-NP-location-640x360.jpg?modified=20221126220708)](https://parks.canada.ca/pn-np/nl/torngats) ### [Torngat Mountains National Park](https://parks.canada.ca/pn-np/nl/torngats) Amid jagged peaks and vast glacial valleys, polar bears and caribou roam the Torngat Mountains, for centuries the homeland of Inuit who today now welcome visitors to experience a dramatic landscape where nature and culture meet. [![](https://pcweb2.azureedge.net/-/media/WET4/proximite-nearby/nl/Hopedale-Mission-NHS-location-640x360.jpg?modified=20221126220707)](https://parks.canada.ca/lhn-nhs/nl/hopedalemission) ### [Hopedale Mission National Historic Site](https://parks.canada.ca/lhn-nhs/nl/hopedalemission) A complex of large, wooden buildings constructed by the Moravian Church at Hopedale, Labrador stand starkly silhouetted against the rocky shoreline of the vast, barren landscape. Official recognition refers to the cultural landscape comprised of the mission buildings on their shoreline site. Date modified : 2026-01-20
